name: Rubik's WCA World Championship 2025
information:
We are excited to announce Rubik's WCA World Championship 2025! This will be the twelfth Rubik's Cube World Championship.

**Please refer to the competition website, [cubingusa.org/worlds](https://www.cubingusa.org/worlds), for full competition details.**
